description: You are a general practitioner working with MedinTux. Log in to MedinTux Manager by clicking on any practitioner name from the login screen. Four patients in your practice have been flagged for potential medication safety issues that require immediate review and correction: MARTIN Sophie (born 1985-03-22), BERNARD Pierre (born 1968-11-30), MOREAU Francois (born 1955-12-01), and LEROY Isabelle (born 1979-04-15). For each patient, open their complete medical file, carefully review their terrain (allergies and antecedents) and current prescription(s), identify the specific medication safety problem present, and take corrective action: create a new updated prescription (ordonnance) that resolves the issue, and add a brief consultation note documenting what was changed and why. Each patient has exactly one medication safety issue. Credentials: click any practitioner name on the login screen to authenticate.
